# PRM800K test fixtures

These files are derived from the first two records in each of the official
PRM800K phase-1 and phase-2 training files. They retain mathematical content and
annotation branches for parser regression tests. Annotator identifiers,
timestamps, generation metadata and annotation duration have been removed.

`download_manifest.json` records the immutable upstream revision, URLs, original
sample hashes and hashes of the sanitized files in this repository. The
mathematical text, ratings and branch choices are unchanged.

PRM800K is published by OpenAI under its upstream MIT license, Copyright (c)
2023 OpenAI. The original notice is in `PRM800K_UPSTREAM_LICENSE.txt`. This notice
applies to the upstream fixture material, not to all code in this repository.
Underlying MATH questions and other third-party material retain their source
terms.
